newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Saudis give $19 million for housing in Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Saudis give $19 million for housing in Jerusalem.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has given $19 million to help poor Palestinians build homes in Arab East Jerusalem, a PLO official said on Tuesday.
"The money is already in the bank," said Adnan Joulani, spokesman for Jerusalem's top PLO official, Faisal al-Husseini.

The Saudis sent the money to a fund at the Islamic Development bank that will dish out loans to 600 Palestinian families to build or refurbish their homes. Saudi Arabia will donate $30 million in future instalments, the spokesman said.
Only Palestinians who already have building permits from Israel are eligible for the loans. Joulani said the loan project would get started in about six weeks.

"This is aimed at funding houses for the many Palestinians who have been displaced by house demolitions or who have been forced to move outside the city because they could not afford to build," Joulani said.
Palestinians complain that Israeli deliberately denies Arabs building permits in the hotly disputed city while building neighbourhoods for Jews.
Israel claims Jerusalem as its undivided capital. Palestinians want the eastern side of the city, which Israel captured in the 1967 Middle East war and later annexed, as capital of a future state.
